data.name: ProductionBuilderFactoryRequiresEnhancedSyntax_Title
data.value: API requires applying 'Farkle.Builder.UseEnhancedSyntaxAttribute'

data.name: ProductionBuilderFactoryRequiresEnhancedSyntax_MessageFormat
data.value: Using class 'Farkle.Builder.Production' requires applying 'Farkle.Builder.UseEnhancedSyntaxAttribute'

data.name: ProductionBuilderFactoryRequiresEnhancedSyntax_Description
data.value: To ensure high performance for the production builder factory source generator, using a method in the 'Farkle.Builder.Production' class requires applying 'UseEnhancedSyntaxAttribute'.

data.value: Invalid usage of 'Farkle.Builder.Production' factory method

data.name: ProductionBuilderFactoryUnsupportedType_Description
data.value: production builder factory methods only support arguments of type 'string' or 'Farkle.Builder.IGrammarSymbol'.

data.name: ProductionBuilderFactoryTooManyTypedSymbols_MessageFormat

data.name: UseEnhancedSyntaxAttributeUnnecessary_Description
data.value: The 'UseEnhancedSyntaxAttribute' attribute is unnecessary on this type or member, as no code in it requires its use.

data.name: SwitchToProductionFactories_Title
data.value: Use 'Production.Build' to create production builder

data.name: SwitchToProductionFactories_MessageFormat
data.value: Use 'Production.Build' instead of 'Append'/'Extend' methods to create production builder

data.name: SwitchToProductionFactories_Description
data.value: Instead of chaining calls to 'Append' and 'Extend' methods to create a production builder, using 'Production.Build' results in more readable and performant code.

data.name: CannotInferProductionBuilderFactoryParameters_MessageFormat
data.value: Cannot infer type of production builder factory arguments. Consider explicitly specifying the types of variables involved in the factory call.

data.name: CannotInferProductionBuilderFactoryParameters_Description
data.value: The production builder factory source generator failed to infer the type of some of the arguments. You can resolve this by explicitly specifying the types of the variables involved in the factory call.
